=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:971-972, 1001-1005 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: During a merge, `git diff --name-only HEAD -- > "${gate_dir}/changed.txt"` lists every file the base branch brought in. The allow-list helper copies all of them, and each path is passed to check_resolver_diff.sh as `--extra-allowed-file`, which turns off invariant 1 for every non-conflicted base-branch file.
  WHY: The model-driven repair turn can rewrite any base-side file. Those edits pass the touched-set check and are committed in the `[ai-merge-resolve]` merge commit, and `_verify_fingerprints_soft` gives no protection on non-integration-sync heads. Severity disagreement: qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:118-136 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `allow` mode adds `failures[].file` from the container-produced `result.json` to the repair allow-list without checking it against the trusted selection (`affected_tests` / `companion_files`). The only filters are syntactic.
  WHY: A PR test can forge `/results/result.json` to name arbitrary repo paths. This widens what the repair editor may edit, and in the resolver those paths become `--extra-allowed-file` values. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it BLOCKER, four reviewers MAJOR, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 NIT (impact limited because review mode already has the full sandbox scope).
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:161-180, 261-280 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `validate_snapshot` calls `exit 1` on container_survived and on validator rc 3|124|125|126|127|137. The post-repair call `if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ] && validate_snapshot; then` does not contain that exit, and `heal_prepush_test_gate || true` cannot catch it.
  WHY: A validator infrastructure failure after the repair turn exits the heal before the `source.pre-gate` restore and the transfer at line 278 run. The already-validated first-turn edit is lost, which contradicts the "Fail-open: the transfer below always follows" header. Severity disagreement: qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3651-3662 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` is set only in the "Pre-push affected-test gate" step env (line 3657). The resolver (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:948) and heal (scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:224) never receive it and fall back to `repair`.
  WHY: Setting `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE=off` (the documented rollback) or `report` affects only the review-editor step. The resolver and heal still run the container gate and the extra repair turn, so the changelog claim "controls all four paths" is false. Severity disagreement: qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:939-940, 948 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `local gate_step="${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-scripts}/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh"` and the matching `gate_sandbox_sh` fall back to a relative `scripts/` path. This bypasses the step script's own absolute-path guard `review_prepush_test_gate_abs` and the `test_relative_support_dir_is_never_trusted` contract.
  WHY: When SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR is unset, the credential-bearing resolver (GH_PAT) runs PR-controlled helper scripts. Today's callers export SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR, so the fallback is normally dead code. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it BLOCKER, minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus MAJOR, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash NIT (a hardening gap, not a live break).
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:27918-27953 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_integration_judge_invalid_answer_is_retried_within_lifetime_cap` fails in CI run 40335511559, shard 2 (`orchestrate-poll (1)`), with `exit_1` (33 passed, 1 failed). This turns the required `CI / lint` aggregate red on head d5a2c15.
  WHY: Required CI stays red and auto-merge is refused. The failure does not map to a PR hunk (the only edit to this file is the `OPTIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` literal at line 25214) and may come from the merge with main or be a flake. qwen_qwen3_7-plus reported this only as an additional note.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:254-255 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Heal calls `repair-prompt` without the third ALLOW_FILE argument, so the prompt has no `=== EFFECTIVE REPAIR ALLOW-LIST ===` section. prompts/mode-implement-repair-tests.txt:28 still says "edit only the files listed under EFFECTIVE REPAIR ALLOW-LIST".
  WHY: In effect the heal repair turn is told it may edit nothing, so PR-caused test failures go into the transfer unrepaired. The heal test passes only because its fake editor ignores the prompt.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:937-1055 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The resolver gate combines two implicit-execution risks: it runs `gate_step`/`gate_sandbox_sh` through a relative-path fallback, and it builds the allow-list from the entire merge diff passed as `--extra-allowed-file`.
  WHY: Together these let an attacker-controlled PR rewrite arbitrary base-branch files, and the result is committed through `[ai-merge-resolve]`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:466-467 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `review_prepush_test_gate_main` starts with `set +eu` and `set +o pipefail`, which disables error checking for the whole function.
  WHY: Unexpected errors are masked and execution continues. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this: it calls the setting the deliberate never-blocking fail-open contract.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:975 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The resolver calls `repair-prompt` at line 975 but does not check that the prompt file was created before passing it to `_resolver_sandbox_attempt` at lines 984, 988 and 991.
  WHY: If repair-prompt fails, the sandbox attempt runs with a missing or empty prompt. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this: `_resolver_sandbox_attempt` is reached only inside the `if ... repair-prompt ...; then` branch.
- scripts/check_resolver_diff.sh:63-71 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A trailing `--extra-allowed-file` with no value reaches `shift 2`, which fails under `set -euo pipefail` with "shift count out of range".
  WHY: The script exits 1 instead of the documented usage exit 2, and the caller at review_conflict_resolve.sh:1004-1005 treats that as a revert. It is not reachable through the current caller.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:229-243 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The manifest baseline is taken from the heal checkout's working tree, including untracked non-ignored files, but the gate tree is a clean `worktree add --detach ... HEAD`. scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:449-452 refuses the transfer when they differ.
  WHY: In a dirty checkout the gate always logs `outcome=unverified reason=gate_tree_unavailable` and silently tests nothing. It fails open.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

No hunk adds it to the resolver step env, exports it via GITHUB_ENV, or forwards it to the heal invocation, and both scripts default to `repair`. implement.yml is not in the issue's files_touched list.
